qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the chain sprocket to injection pump?
What is the torque value for the toothed belt pulley to injection pump?
What screw type is specified for the toothed belt pulley to injection pump?
What is the torque specification for the chain tensioner?
What type of screw is used for the chain tensioner?
Which component in the injection pump drive section has the highest torque specification?
qa_pairs.answer: The toothed belt pulley to injection pump at 50 Nm

qa_pairs.question: What section number covers the injection pump drive specifications?
How many components are listed under the injection pump drive section?
qa_pairs.answer: Three components: chain sprocket to injection pump, toothed belt pulley to injection pump, and chain tensioner
